name: Southern-gooseberry
desc: Southern-gooseberry (Vaccinium stamineum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vaccinium stamineum, commonly known as deerberry, tall deerberry, highbush huckleberry, buckberry, and southern gooseberry, is a North American species of flowering plant in the heath family.
